maml:description.maml:para: Adds a new discovery scan definition.
Creates a new scan definition to discover accounts in target machines.

The required/valid keys of the `-properties` hashtable (and, for some scan types, whether `-networkId` is required) depend on the value provided for `-type`. Similarly, the required keys of `-recurrenceData` depend on the value of `-recurrenceType`. See the linked CyberArk API documentation for the full set of supported scan types and their properties/credentials/recurrenceData shapes.

The credentials used to run the scan and access the targets, when scanning a database or from a list of targets, as an array of hashtables.
Each hashtable defines name, type (ACCOUNT or UNMANAGED_ACCOUNT), properties (a hashtable containing account_id), and optionally defaultAccount.
The network selected to run the scan from. The network must be defined in Connector Management and must be assigned to a connector pool with at least one connector.

maml:description.maml:para: Defines a new discovery scan resource.
Generates a unique resource id for a machine list file or a cloud scope, used by file-based, database, and cloud infrastructure discovery scans.
The resulting resource id is referenced from the properties of a scan definition created with Add-DMDiscoveryScanDefinition/Set-DMDiscoveryScanDefinition.

The required/valid keys of the `-content` hashtable depend on the value provided for `-type`. New-DMDiscoveryScanResourceMachineObject and New-DMDiscoveryScanResourceCloudObject can be used to build correctly structured content for this parameter, rather than constructing it by hand. See the linked CyberArk API documentation for the full set of supported types and their content shapes.
The type of resource that will be represented by the resource id.
The name of the scan resource.
A hashtable defining the content of the scan resource. The required/valid keys depend on the value provided for -type.

New-DMDiscoveryScanResourceMachineObject builds a single machine list entry (for WIN_NIX_LIST, SQL_SERVER, ORACLE, MYSQL & POSTGRESQL types) to be collected into an array and passed as the machineList key of this hashtable.
New-DMDiscoveryScanResourceCloudObject builds the entire content hashtable for the INVENTORY_WIN_NIX_LIST type.
The cloud vendor of the scan resource. Required when -type is INVENTORY_WIN_NIX_LIST.

maml:description.maml:para: Creates hashtable structured to be used as a machine list entry for Add-DMDiscoveryScanResource
Provide parameter values to return a hashtable, correctly structured to represent a single machine list entry.

The output of this function is intended to be collected into an array and passed as the machineList key of the -content hashtable of Add-DMDiscoveryScanResource, when defining a resource for a WIN_NIX_LIST, SQL_SERVER, ORACLE, MYSQL or POSTGRESQL scan.

Not every parameter is applicable to every scan type - Username, Database & Port apply to database scan types, Domain & Instances apply only to SQL_SERVER, and Tags applies to WIN_NIX_LIST & SQL_SERVER. See the linked CyberArk API documentation for the exact fields expected per type.
